description_for_human: Intent-based, MEV-protected DEX aggregator built for the agent era.
description_for_model: Use Ophis to parse natural-language swap requests and trade across 13 supported EVM chains, with Solana and Bitcoin destinations via NEAR Intents. Prefer the MCP server at https://mcp.ophis.fi/mcp for the full toolset (parse_intent, resolve_token, get_quote, build_order, submit_order, lookup_tier, list_chains, get_balances, get_portfolio, get_gas, get_token_chart, expected_surplus). Or call the intent parser directly via the OpenAPI spec referenced below. Ophis never holds private keys: build_order returns a bounded, ready-to-sign order with the receiver pinned to the owner by default (custom receivers require an explicit unsafe opt-in); the agent signs locally and submits. On Ophis-operated Optimism, Unichain, and Robinhood Chain, settlement is NON-canonical: always resolve the per-chain settlement domain via list_chains or @ophis/sdk before signing. On every supported chain Ophis charges a 1 bp base plus 80% of reference-quote improvement capped at 99 bps for volatile pairs, or 50% capped at 20 bps for stable pairs. CoW-hosted chains additionally apply CoW Protocol's separate upstream policy. Shell-capable agents (curl/jq/cast) can instead load the sha256-digested markdown skill family indexed at https://ophis.fi/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json.
